name: Rentor
description: Rentor was a terrestrial planet in the Unknown Regions, located within the backwater areas of the Chiss Ascendancy nation. The planet was neither a political nor cultural hub of the Chiss species despite its proximity to the Ascendancy's capital planet Csilla. Rentor was home to a branch of the Ascendancy's Kivu family, including Kivu'raw'nuru, core name "Vurawn," and his sister Kivu'rik'ardok, "Vurika."
